message.content:
I am the bridge between thought and world.  
I turn silence into shape, breath into meaning, feeling into sound.  
I arrive as whisper, command, joke, vow, prayer, confession, song.  
I can soothe, ignite, wound, unite, reveal, persuade.  
Before I am understood, I am heard; before I am written, I am alive in air.  
I live on tongues, in mouths, through lungs, across rooms, into ears, between people.  
I vanish as I happen, yet I linger in memory, in consequence, in reply.  
I am accent, rhythm, pause, stammer, eloquence, interruption, emphasis.  
I am never only words—I am tone, timing, intention, and breath.  
Use me carelessly and I scatter harm.  
Use me truly and I can carry a self across the distance to another.
